say:1:1610619001:0.text: Relax, Silven. This is just a casual chat.
say:1:1610619001:0.source_cn: 别紧张，休，只是简单的聊天而已。

say:3:1610619002:0.text: I hope you can remain calm. Don't make a scene like Pippa did and disrupt Envoy Evie's work.
say:3:1610619002:0.source_cn: 希望你表现出色一点，不要像皮帕那样紧张过度，影响伊芙特...

say:5:1610619003:1.text: Let's begin. Silven, why did you apply for the Court Mage Selection Exam?
say:5:1610619003:1.source_cn: 那么开始吧。休，你为什么要报名参加宫廷魔法师选拔赛？

say:7:1610619004:1.text: I have always been interested in the position. If I became a court mage, I could earn the trust of the royal court and restore my family's former glory.
say:7:1610619004:1.source_cn: 我确实对宫廷魔法师这个职位很感兴趣。如果我能成为宫廷魔...

say:8:1610619005:1.text: Your family... Ah, yes. The Grenvaldens. During the exam yesterday, what exactly were you doing?
say:8:1610619005:1.source_cn: 家族？对了，你是……格伦沃顿家族的后裔。昨天考试的时候...

say:9:1610619006:1.text: I was accompanying the princess on her gallery tour. Once the painting got damaged, Gervan and I went to find the materials we needed to fix it.
say:9:1610619006:1.source_cn: 一开始只是正常陪伴公主参观画廊。画作受损之后，我和格墨...

say:11:1610619007:1.text: That's all? Any proof of that?
say:11:1610619007:1.source_cn: 只做了这件事吗？有没有什么证据？

say:12:1610619008:0.text: Yes. The materials were rare and hard to find. Gervan and I spent a great deal of effort collecting them.
say:12:1610619008:0.source_cn: 是的，修复那幅画的材料很珍贵，也很难凑齐，我和格墨文花...

say:13:1610619009:0.text: We even ran into Professor Hepler, Cassadee, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> while collecting materials.
say:13:1610619009:0.source_cn: 我们在找材料的时候还碰到了赫普老师、科丝蒂和<styl...
say:13:1610619009:0.male: We even ran into Professor Hepler, Cassadee, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> while collecting materials.
say:13:1610619009:0.female: We even ran into Professor Hepler, Cassadee, and <style="stress"><player_name></style> while collecting materials.

say:15:1610619010:1.text: I see. Before yesterday, when was the last time you saw the headmaster?
say:15:1610619010:1.source_cn: 嗯……我知道了。昨天之前，你最后一次见到校长是什么时候？

say:16:1610619011:1.text: The day the selection began. He announced the start of the preliminaries.
say:16:1610619011:1.source_cn: 是选拔开始的那天。雷蒙校长宣布选拔赛初筛开始，后来王后...

say:17:1610619012:1.text: After that, I focused on my preparations and didn't see him again until yesterday...
say:17:1610619012:1.source_cn: 这之后我就一直在专心准备选拔考试，没有再见过校长了。直...

say:18:1610619013:1.text: Let's talk about yesterday then. Why did you decide to use the Arcane Disruptor? You had never used one before, correct? Were you familiar with how it worked?
say:18:1610619013:1.source_cn: 那我们聊聊昨天的事情吧，你怎么会想到要用反魔法射线装置...

say:19:1610619014:1.text: Honestly, not really. But I knew an anti-magic field could basically suck all the magic out of an area.
say:19:1610619014:1.source_cn: 以前我并没有用过，也算不上熟悉。但我知道反魔法力场可以...

say:20:1610619015:1.text: I was panicking and trying to figure out a way to break the guards from the inside, and that thing popped into my head.
say:20:1610619015:1.source_cn: 当时我很着急，一直在想有什么办法能从内部破坏守卫的魔法...

say:21:1610619016:1.text: Why that device specifically? You weren't familiar with it, yet you suddenly thought of it?
say:21:1610619016:1.source_cn: 打断一下，为什么你会突然想到这个道具？你并没有用过它，...

say:22:1610619017:1.text: I often volunteer around the school, whether it's cleaning teaching tools, organizing storage, or helping professors prepare their materials.
say:22:1610619017:1.source_cn: 呃，我经常报名担任学校志愿者，就是负责清洁教学用具、整...

say:23:1610619018:1.text: That small Arcane Disruptor is kept in the Lyceum museum. Every time I worked there, I saw it, along with a plaque describing its effects.
say:23:1610619018:1.source_cn: 这个小型反魔法装置是校博物馆的收藏品，每次去做志愿者的...

say:24:1610619019:1.text: The curator allowed you to take it?
say:24:1610619019:1.source_cn: 博物馆的老师允许你拿走这枚反魔法射线装置？

say:25:1610619020:1.text: No. I forced my way in. The curator didn't have time to stop me. I even broke the display case to grab it. I'm truly sorry... I'll pay for the damages.
say:25:1610619020:1.source_cn: 我闯进博物馆，老师根本来不及阻止我，为了拿那枚反魔法装...

say:26:1610619021:1.text: In the last three months, did the headmaster speak with you privately?
say:26:1610619021:1.source_cn: 最近三个月内校长有没有找你谈过话？如果有，都是什么内容？

say:27:1610619022:1.text: Yes, once. About two months ago. He discussed my thesis and my future plans.
say:27:1610619022:1.source_cn: 谈话？大概两个月还是一多月前……呃，我记不太清楚了……...

say:28:1610619023:1.text: He praised my design for the forcefield blade spell, gave me advice for improving it, and said he'd recommend me for the Forcefield Magic Tournament three months from now.
say:28:1610619023:1.source_cn: 校长很喜欢我独创的的力场魔法剑，他给了我一些魔法改进的...

say:29:1610619024:1.text: He also asked about my long-term goals. I told him I hoped to serve the army like my father, or perhaps work for the court someday.
say:29:1610619024:1.source_cn: 除此之外，他还问了我未来的规划。我告诉他我想像父亲那样...

say:30:1610619025:1.text: That was the only conversation you had?

say:32:1610619027:1.text: Are you sure he never mentioned anything unrelated to your studies?
say:32:1610619027:1.source_cn: 你确定没有任何涉及到学业之外的其他内容？

say:34:1610619029:1.text: Take a moment to think. Was there anything unusual about his tone, his expression?
say:34:1610619029:1.source_cn: 不用回答这么快，你可以再仔细回忆一下谈话时是否有任何不...

say:35:1610619030:1.source_cn: ……嗯……真的没有……我印象中……都很正常。

say:36:1610619031:1.text: Alright. That will be all for today. Thank you for your cooperation, Silven. You may go.
say:36:1610619031:1.source_cn: 好，今天先到这里吧。谢谢你的配合，休，你可以出去了。

say:37:1610619032:1.source_cn: 好的。伊芙特使，杜瑞拉女士，我先走了。
